en: The postcard features a collage of old black-and-white photographs arranged in a circular manner. The images appear to depict small buildings, rural landscapes, and possibly a river or lake. Hand-drawn floral decorations are present along the border of the card, giving it a vintage decorative feel. In the center, the word 'Soe.' is clearly written in a traditional serif font.
